starts.how: Speak to him; he agrees to let you join if you handle some first tasks.

firstStep: Speak to Kodlak Whitemane in Jorrvaskr

takesYou.why: give Vilkas' sword to Eorlund Gray-Mane

objectives: Spar with Vilkas in the training yard behind Jorrvaskr
Give Vilkas' sword to Forgemaster Eorlund Grey-Mane, at the Skyforge

rewards.what: Membership in the Companions, with a bed in Jorrvaskr

opens: work for the Companions (Animal Extermination, Animal Pelt Collection and the other jobs)

people.name: Kodlak Whitemane
people.role: Harbinger of the Companions; lets you join

people.name: Vilkas
people.role: spars with you in the training yard

people.name: Eorlund Gray-Mane
people.role: forgemaster at the Skyforge; takes Vilkas' sword

people.name: Aela the Huntress
people.role: gets her repaired shield back

people.name: Farkas
people.role: shows you to your quarters

people.name: Skjor
people.role: can point you to Kodlak

unsure.why: Narrative Gameplay Consistent Dialogue Tweaks puts a skill/Health/Stamina check on some of Aela's opening lines, Companions Dialogue Bundle takes it off, and LoreRim - Dialogue Patch (later) puts it back. The line text isn't in these files, so it's unclear whether it only changes Aela's greeting or also blocks being sent to Kodlak; Farkas, Skjor and Vilkas also have send-you-to-Kodlak lines.
Vilkas Spar Skip.esp loosens the conditions on a line tied to the spar with Vilkas, which suggests a way to skip the fight; the line text isn't in these files.
Eorlund Gray-Mane is placed in House Gray-Mane; the objective sends you to him at the Skyforge. His daily schedule isn't in these files.

The Companions' shared script lists gold, Beast Form, Beastblood and a disabled Ring of Hircine power, and Companions Dialogue Bundle adds an 'Inspired' spell from Skjor's advice; none of these is tied to finishing this quest in the records. Vilkas's Sword and Aela's Shield are the quest items you carry.

INFO Companions Dialogue Bundle.esp:00080E-000818 (where is Kodlak)

unsure.why: Who or what sets the first stage isn't in these files; the first objective is the funeral, so it most likely starts when you get back from Driftshade Sanctuary.
The funeral spot is a marker the quest fills at runtime; Kodlak's body is placed outdoors in Whiterun. Eorlund is placed in House Gray-Mane; his schedule isn't in these files.

Wuuthrad is given by the quest's stage script and the Shield of Ysgramor is a quest alias; the exact moment each is handed over isn't shown. The script also holds a Wolf Helmet for Vilkas, which doesn't look like a player reward.
Later Companions jobs (such as Purity and Totems of Hircine) are in the same line, but the records here don't show what unlocks them.
